scenarios.title: Accelerated Growth
scenarios.summary: Join a venture-backed Series A startup as the Lead Engineer, taking significant equity compensation.

timeline.title: Bootstrap System
timeline.description: Rebuild legacy architecture, configure scale thresholds.

timeline.title: Equity Realization
timeline.description: Achieve milestone vesting, lead a growing core dev division.

timeline.title: Scale Liquidity
timeline.description: Venture secondary sales, leverage personal equity reserves.

scenarios.estimated_costs: Sweat equity investment, 15% below market cash base
scenarios.expected_benefits: Generational wealth upside via equity, rapid network expansion
scenarios.opportunity_cost: $25,000 yearly cash differential compared to corporate paths
scenarios.reasoning: Fits your 'Builder' archetype and 'Growth Over Balance' priorities perfectly.

scenarios.title: Balanced Path
scenarios.summary: Accept a Senior Software Engineer position at a mid-sized public technology company with stable salary and stock.

timeline.title: Stabilize Role
timeline.description: Deliver core features, map promotions path.

timeline.title: Lead Engineer Promotion
timeline.description: Assume team leadership, vest first batch of RSUs.

scenarios.expected_benefits: High liquid savings rate, robust work-life separation
scenarios.opportunity_cost: Missed early startup equity upside and rapid scaling experience
scenarios.reasoning: Appeals to your 'Balanced' risk profile while maintaining professional growth.

scenarios.title: Defensive Hedge
scenarios.summary: Remain in current role as a Senior Dev, negotiate 100% remote flexibility and start a high-margin freelance consulting gig.

timeline.title: Remote Optimization
timeline.description: Streamline day job throughput, secure first freelance client.

timeline.title: Consulting Expansion
timeline.description: Double freelance billing rates, register LLC.

timeline.title: Consulting Transition
timeline.description: Option to transition full time to LLC or maintain low-risk mix.

pros: No single point of job failure
scenarios.expected_benefits: Direct diversification of income streams, independent cash reserves
scenarios.opportunity_cost: Corporate promotion progress and executive leadership experience
scenarios.reasoning: Leverages your 'Invest Aggressively' financial style by maximizing freelance cash reserves.

disclaimer: This prototype simulation models trade-offs based on hardcoded scenario matrices for hackathon showcase.

recommendations.Strategic Fit: Venture Lead Engineer (Scenario A) yields the highest long-term leverage but freelancing (Scenario C) provides superior near-term liquidity.
recommendations.Tactical Move: If near-term capital is vital, select Scenario C. If builder autonomy dominates, Scenario A is your choice.
